pipeline_localization.extractor: not explained (14 controlled factors show no systematic silence effect)
pipeline_localization.validator: UNEXPLAINED - eventnominal 15/15 vs recipient 6/16 on valid items; lexical within-source 3/5 vs 3/9 (no framing effect)
pipeline_localization.postfilter: no hard drop: of 28 validator-ACCEPT items 15 ACCEPT, 10 WARN (UNKNOWN_TRIGGER), 3 ABSTAIN (entity gate), 0 REJECT; deny controls 18 WARN / 4 ABSTAIN / 0 ACCEPT

probe_addendum.finding: pooled 25/37 vs 3/11 directional, but primary lexical within-source 3/5 vs 3/9 shows none; per frozen rule this is a source/material artifact, not an Assertion effect

standing_statement: 14 controlled factors and the assertion-scope test do not explain the batch-6 silences. The validator stage carries the one unexplained split (15/15 vs 6/16). The PostFilter and linker/worthiness stages remove no correct extraction. These are candidate exclusions, not a proof that no linguistic factor remains.
